snippet.title: WHEEL WORLD | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
wheels are in motion and fates are shifting

the ride begins when Wheel World rolls onto PC, PS5 & Xbox Series X|S July 23, 2025

Wishlist today:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497460/Wheel_World/
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012810
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/wheel-world/9NGCFDHR2MV3/0010

Welcome to Wheel World, where the fate of the universe rests on your handlebars.

You are Kat, a young cyclist with one mission: save Wheel World from total collapse. Explore a stunning open world filled with impressive vistas, hidden secrets, and races that will test your skills. Customize your bike with an endless array of parts, from sleek speedsters to off-road beasts—there's no limit to how you can ride.

Song: “Hold On” by JOON

-

Connect with Joon! 

Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/5velmxw0WUhaJm9PeeXpWE?si=LjvF0PxmRIupLbRo7xFQSQ
Bandcamp: https://templeofjoon.bandcamp.com/?label=3083277547&tab=artists
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/templeofjoon/
Apple Music: https://music.apple.com/us/artist/joon/1507484578
